review.body: { if ! host (& material . host_identity) { return Err (EncodingError :: Shape) ; } Ok (array ([text (AUTHENTICATION_EDITION) , bytes (& material . run) , bytes (& material . actor_key) , text (& material . host_identity) , bytes (& material . host_key) ,]) . to_canonical_bytes ()) }
